## Algorithm

* [Per-channel budget allocation: α split, Neyman re-split and coverage floors](channel-budget-allocation.md) - Deterministic per-channel N_j (ByAlpha, or Neyman ∝ s_j); floors of MIN_CHANNEL_NEVAL/acceptance capped at 4× that override --neval on wide splits; the starvation and redundancy they caused.
* [Convergence-targeted integration: --target-rel and the stop rule](convergence-stop-rule.md) - integrate stops when the sum of channel variances, each widened by a pooled consistency factor max(1, emp/quoted), meets --target-rel (0.1% default) after min_iters, capped at 500 iterations.
* [Cut-implied timelike floors, xqcut and the τ bound](cut-implied-timelike-floors.md) - Cuts::timelike_floor's provable bounds on subsystem invariants, how they enter the maps, the bias oracle, why xqcut floors are already in the maps, and why a tighter τ floor was dropped.
* [MadEvent's single-diagram enhancement and get_channel_cut](madevent-single-diagram-enhancement.md) - SMATRIX weights channel c by AMP2_c·CC_c at sde_strategy 1 and by CC_c alone at 2; CC ≡ 1 when tmin_for_channel = −1; the induced P(c|p) is partition-free.
* [Multichannel phase space and α-adaptation](multichannel.md) - Channels combined by 1/Σα_j g_j, Kleiss–Pittau α refinement driven by the integrand over (group, diagram) channels, the survey's cost, and our density-share channel label vs MadEvent's AMP2 share.
* [Massive RAMBO](rambo.md) - The Kleiss–Stirling–Ellis massive RAMBO map and weight, its F-generic signature, and the uniforms-replay oracle that pins it.
* [Breit–Wigner, massless-pole and forced-resonance maps for timelike invariants](resonance-and-pole-maps.md) - BW tan substitution, the logarithmic map for zero-width poles with its floor, ForcedResonances windows for decay chains (union over pairings), and how MadEvent's setgrid/cut_bw differ.
* [Soft-shaped 2-body split angle (SoftSplit) with energy floors](soft-shaped-split-angle.md) - Draws a split's angle from the parent's flight direction with density ∝ 1/(E₁E₂) inside cut-implied energy floors: the z(1−z) structure, the map, reciprocity, and where it fires.
* [The multi-rung t-channel spine](t-channel-spine.md) - Spacelike lines nest into an ordered rung chain of peripheral 2-body steps: the logarithmic t map and its Jacobian, beam anchoring, flat fallback, multi-body spines, and the ordering firing test.
* [The VEGAS integrator: grid adaptation, damping, adapt and frozen phases](vegas-integrator.md) - VegasGrid's Lepage importance grid, the damping exponent (1.5 raw, 0.5 on mapped multichannel integrands), adapt vs sample_frozen, serialisation, and what VEGAS+ would add.

## Caveat

* [Adapted VEGAS grids make a heavy weight tail](vegas-grid-weight-tail.md) - Adapting on Σ(f·w)² starves low-acceptance bins, giving Pareto tails (Hill index ≤2) so w_max and file-to-file σ never settle; MadEvent's acceptance rescale is a partial cure.

## Derivation

* [Fixed beams with masses: ŝ, CM energies, flux and frames](fixed-beam-kinematics.md) - Beams on their own mass shells at run-card energies; ŝ, E* and |p*| via Källén; Møller flux 2λ^½; records in the CM frame, rapidity cuts boosted to the lab.

## Design

* [Phase-space seam: maps, channels, combiners and the density contract](channel-contract.md) - PhaseSpaceMap/Channel/Combiner traits; sample()'s walk weight vs the combiner's Σα·g from density(), positive at foreign points; cut-first pricing; the subtree memo.
* [Integration channels: MadGraph's merged configurations, merged again by map identity](channel-set.md) - One channel per config_groups group (coherent |ΣAMP|², channel cuts per configuration), then one hadronic sampling channel per distinct map; MadEvent's config_subproc_map compared.
* [Per-diagram channels from the propagator chain](diagram-channels.md) - How a diagram's Prop chain becomes a 2-body decomposition tree, with non-prefix s-channel recovery and the beam-content rule that survives feyngraph's momentum routing.
* [Mixed-multiplicity composite integrand](mixed-multiplicity-integrand.md) - MultiplicitySum: one ProtonIntegrand per @N multiplicity with its own channels and grid dimension (channel_grid_ndim), a budget split by part spread, union-shape maps, versioned keys.

## Design Decision

* [Sample hadronic collisions in (τ, y), with channels rebuilt at each event energy](hadronic-tau-y-sampling.md) - A mass window is a thin diagonal band in (x₁,x₂) that VEGAS misses (6% low); in (τ,y) it is a 1-D bound on τ. ScaledMultiChannel then draws at each point's √ŝ.
* [Phase-space map choices: --map-* flags, the auto rules and the measurements behind them](map-choices.md) - MapOptions/MapChoices (split angle, τ map, rung order); auto = soft-emission / log τ / derived order, banked in the artifact; why soft-all and 1/τ² stay options, from 20-seed evaluations-to-0.1%.
* [One VEGAS grid per multichannel term](per-channel-vegas-grids.md) - Each channel gets its own frozen grid in its own map coordinates as MadEvent does, so errors and w_max are per channel; absolute grid coordinates are designed, not built.
* [Counter-based RNG substreams and thread-count-independent integration](rng-substreams-and-parallel-determinism.md) - ChaCha8 addressed by (stream, position) replaces RANMAR; each chunk seeks its substream by global point index and reduces in point order, so -j changes wall time, never a bit of the artifact.
* [Regulate massless t-channel transfers with a cut-implied spacelike floor](spacelike-floor.md) - Where cuts imply a floor ((max single-leg pT cut)²), bound each rung's t_max at −floor and keep a token pole; elsewhere use the flat fallback. With the before/after σ that decided it.
* [VEGAS iterations combine by unweighted mean after a warm-up](vegas-iteration-combination.md) - Lepage's 1/σ² iteration weighting correlates weights with estimates and biases σ low at small budgets; default is the arithmetic mean with warm-up 2, InverseVariance kept for goldens.

## Physics Convention

* [Identical final-state particle factor](identical-particle-factor.md) - 1/∏ n_s! over outgoing species keyed on (id, polarization), from phasespace::identical_particle_factor, applied per subprocess, never in a map weight.
